title: Amazon warns NYC customers that they could be charged up to $5 more per order if the City Council passes a bill requiring it to directly hire delivery workers (Lisa Fickenscher/New York Post)
summary: Lisa Fickenscher / New York Post: Amazon warns NYC customers that they could be charged up to $5 more per order if the City Council passes a bill requiring it to directly hire delivery workers — Amazon customers in New York City will be charged up to $5 more per order if the local government passes a controversial bill aimed …
